goal: Decide what December live trading will run on: put the surviving edge leads to the test, wire FinBERT and an LLM gate in **shadow only**, and list what Systems 1, 2 and 3 must change before real money.
context: 22 parameter searches: 0 PASS. Combined book Sharpe −1.86 — single-pair technical rules are exhausted.
NAV ≈ 80.3k against 100k paid in. The gatekeeper is miscalibrated (Brier 0.348 vs a 0.230 base rate).
Leads still standing: vol_managed_carry, post_fomc_drift, weak_voters_committee, month-end (H-04), value (H-09), and the inside_bar_continuation NEAR.
